winks.rationale: 'Smith' is an extremely common exact US place root (Smithville, Smithfield, Smith County), but too generic to be pointed.
'Cuba' is an exact-name US town in New York, Missouri, Illinois, and Alabama, read directly off the word.
'Roosevelt' is an exact-name town in Utah and a county in Montana/New Mexico, read straight off the surname.
'Cooper' is an exact US place root (Cooperstown NY, Cooper County MO, Cooper TX).
'Carnegie' is an exact-name borough in Pennsylvania and a town in Oklahoma.
First name 'Alexander' is an exact-name US county (NC, IL) and town read straight off the word.
'Calder' is reported as a small unincorporated place in Idaho; faint and uncertain to exist.
'Baldwin' is an exact-name place in New York, Florida, and Baldwin County in Alabama/Georgia.
'Horne' sounds like 'Horn'; faint match to features like Horn Mountain or Hornell NY.
'Holiday' is an exact-name census-designated place near Tarpon Springs, Florida.
'Graham' is an exact-name town in North Carolina and Texas, and Graham County in NC/AZ.
'Washington' is an exact-name town in many states (NC, GA, PA) plus the state and county; very common.
'Hewitt' is an exact-name city in Texas and a town in Wisconsin/New Jersey.
'Winifred' is an exact-name small town in Montana, read straight off the first name.
'Mason' is an exact-name town and county in Texas, Ohio, Michigan, West Virginia.
'Berkshire' is also a small town in New York, distinct from the MA county named here.
'Cedar Grove' is an exact-name community in North Carolina, New Jersey, and Indiana, separate from the LA original.
'Buffalo' is an exact-name town in Wyoming, South Dakota, Missouri, and Minnesota beyond the NY city.
'Becket' sounds like 'Beckett'; faint and uncertain match.
The literal word 'Snow' begins many US places (Snowmass CO, Snow Hill NC, Snowflake AZ); faint as a full-name match.
The literal metal 'copper' begins real US places like Copper Harbor MI and Copper Mountain CO.
The literal word 'brass' begins Brasstown NC and Brasstown Bald GA.
The literal word 'Stone' begins many real US places (Stone Mountain GA, Stoneville NC, Stone County).
Contains the generic feature word 'Mountain'; too generic to point at a specific place.
First name 'Pearl' is an exact-name city in Mississippi and Pearl River in MS/LA.
'Lookout Mountain' is also a town in Georgia and the ridge spans TN/GA/AL.
